$comment: VERIFIED image records for the Emperium of Wynn announcements channel. The export holds 39 "Image" markers and 13 attachments, the rest being link previews, so ordinal placement was checked against content rather than trusted. Marker 10 is EXCLUDED: it is a critic's post alleging that a member guild had a racist name, an unsubstantiated accusation this wiki will not republish. Its original is kept as evidence; the web derivative has been deleted and nothing may cite it.

textBefore: As for myself, I am A’renos. I am a simple member of this alliance just like any of you. In fact, there are so many others in this alliance who are greater than me. Motoki1 and yosterics for example, they own guilds that has been around for a long time and has essentially made it number 2 and 3 on the leader boards. That is a great achievement. Others such as smatsu7 and Tntdestroyd, their constant effort within wars and the maintenance of the alliance is spectacular. There are many others within the alliance who are far more active and overall are better than myself, and I only ever want them to be. I want everyone to become greater than me, and I will show them how. I will teach all who come to me in how they should treat others, how to war or to lead, how to create events and execute grand balls within the community.

I am the Shadow Advisor of this alliance, but I am not its leader. I oversee what happens, and I advise. I have brought each one of you here together for a purpose, which is to make one of my dreams come true. The unification of the whole guild community of Wynn as well as the destruction of all guild hate. Those are the main goals of this alliance, and I will continue to be with the TEoW until they are complete. Lastly, I want to share something with you.
They can destroy what i care about, but i can remake it.
